content:
Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd. is a premier chemical manufacturing company located in the vibrant city of Baroda, Gujarat, at 102 Sudhan Apartment, Opp Tejas School, Race Course. Since our inception, we have committed ourselves to excellence in the production and supply of high-quality chemical products tailored to meet the diverse needs of various industries. Our strategic position in Baroda, an economic hub known for its rich industrial heritage, allows us to effectively cater to both domestic and international markets, ensuring timely delivery and superior service.

At Minol Acid and Chemicals, we specialize in a wide range of chemical solutions including acids, solvents, and specialty chemicals that are essential for industries such as pharmaceuticals, agriculture, textiles, and manufacturing. Our state-of-the-art facility is equipped with advanced technology and adheres to stringent quality control measures, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and effectiveness standards. We pride ourselves on our dedicated research and development team that continually strives to innovate and improve our product offerings, keeping pace with the ever-evolving market demands.

Moreover, we are committed to sustainability and environmentally friendly practices, prioritizing the health of our community and ecosystems. With a focus on integrity, quality, and customer satisfaction, Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd. is poised to be a trusted partner in the chemical industry for years to come.
